description: Khyber Tobacco Company Limited was established in 1954 and is a cigarette manufacturer and tobacco exporter based at Nowshera Road, Mardan in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The company says it has built research and development in blending formulas and sells its brands in both domestic and export markets.
headOffice: Nowshera Road, Mardan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan
